name: api-endpoint-input-boundary-probes
approach: Curl-driven probe matrix over all 23 public + 7 admin API routes. Per endpoint: empty body, wrong content-type, oversized payload, plus method-specific edge cases. Admin endpoints additionally probed without bearer.

real_defects_fixed.title: 500 on oversized / malformed JSON body
real_defects_fixed.evidence: 500KB junk body returned HTTP 500 with body `{"error":"Something went wrong"}`. The route validates question.length > 1000 but only AFTER req.json() — and that throws on non-JSON, escaping into the generic catch as 500.
real_defects_fixed.fix: Pre-check content-length > 50KB → 413. Wrap req.json() in inner try → 400 on parse failure.

real_defects_fixed.title: 500 on oversized / malformed JSON body
real_defects_fixed.evidence: 200KB junk body returned HTTP 500 + empty body. Same root cause as A1 — req.json() throws.

passed_probes.endpoint: Admin × 7 routes (questions, reviews, trip-reports, sos, stay-picks, citations, revalidate)
passed_probes.scope: Admin auth gating verified across all 7 admin POST routes.

passed_probes.note: Today's earlier J1 fix (commit 3700ca27) verified working in production.

probes: id=<script>alert(1)</script> → 404 'No coordinates for this destination' (no XSS reflection — script tags are URL-decoded as a slug lookup that misses, returns plain JSON error) ✓

passed_probes.probe: honeypot field `hp` populated → silent drop (200) confirmed in code review
passed_probes.note: Honeypot is correctly named `hp`, not `website`/`url` (those names would be too obvious to bots). Silent-drop pattern matches OWASP guidance.

carried_forward.title: UGC rate-limit observability
carried_forward.description: Code review confirms rate-limit logic on questions/reviews/trip-reports/suggestions routes (RATE_LIMIT_PER_HOUR = 3 etc), but did not run 60-rapid-request load test in this phase. Worth verifying limits actually trigger 429s.
carried_forward.next_step: Phase 9 security pass adds the rapid-request probe.

carried_forward.title: Other req.json() routes worth auditing
carried_forward.description: log-bot-visit, quiz-match, embed routes do wrap their req.json() in try/catch already (verified by code read).
